displayName: Sentinel Signal MCP for Healthcare Claims Scoring
description: Hosted MCP server for denial risk, prior authorization, reimbursement scoring, usage, and feedback. Includes no-signup trial keys and Smithery support.

rawRecord.displayName: Sentinel Signal MCP for Healthcare Claims Scoring
rawRecord.description: Hosted MCP server for denial risk, prior authorization, reimbursement scoring, usage, and feedback. Includes no-signup trial keys and Smithery support.

detail.displayName: Sentinel Signal MCP for Healthcare Claims Scoring
detail.description: Hosted MCP server for denial risk, prior authorization, reimbursement scoring, usage, and feedback. Includes no-signup trial keys and Smithery support.

sentinelApiKey.description: Optional. Use your own Sentinel API key for account-bound quota and usage.

sentinelApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override for private or self-hosted Sentinel API environments.

sentinelTokenBaseUrl.description: Optional override for minting trial keys outside the default hosted environment.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List supported workflows and current model versions via GET /v1/workflows

tools.name: get_workflow_schema
tools.description: Fetch required fields, optional fields, enums, and an example payload for a workflow via GET /v1/workflows/{workflow}/schema

workflow.description: Workflow identifier such as healthcare.denial, healthcare.prior_auth, or healthcare.reimbursement.

tools.name: validate_workflow_payload
tools.description: Validate and normalize a workflow payload without consuming a scoring call via POST /v1/workflows/{workflow}/validate

payload.description: Workflow payload to validate before scoring.

workflow.description: Workflow identifier such as healthcare.denial, healthcare.prior_auth, or healthcare.reimbursement.

tools.name: score_workflow
tools.description: Score denial risk, prior auth, and reimbursement workflows via POST /v1/score

options.description: Optional scoring flags such as explanation or threshold controls.

payload.description: Structured workflow payload matching Sentinel /v1/score for the selected workflow.

workflow.description: Workflow identifier such as denial, prior_auth, reimbursement, or unified_score.

tools.name: score_batch
tools.description: Score up to 25 workflow items sequentially in one request via POST /v1/score/batch

items.description: List of scoring items, each containing workflow, payload, and optional options.

continue_on_error.description: When true, later items continue even if an earlier item fails.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Retrieve plan limits, trial quota, and upgrade state via GET /v1/limits

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Retrieve monthly scoring call usage via GET /v1/usage

month.description: Optional billing month in YYYY-MM format.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit structured claims outcome feedback via POST /v1/feedback

feedback.description: Structured feedback payload for a prior Sentinel scoring event.

prompts.name: claims_triage_prompt
prompts.description: Help an agent choose the right healthcare claims workflow and required payload fields before scoring.

prompts.name: explain_score_prompt
prompts.description: Help an agent interpret a Sentinel score and decide what operational action to take next.
